applications.name: Jyväskylä district heat letter of intent (Steady Energy and Alva-yhtiöt Oy)
applications.power_class: 100-300 MW heat (2-6 LDR-50 units, 50 MW thermal each)
applications.timeline: letter of intent signed 2026-05-19; one-year preliminary study launched
applications.what_it_says: Steady Energy and Alva-yhtiöt Oy signed a letter of intent to study nuclear district heat for Jyväskylä. Steady Energy says it could supply the city with between two and six LDR-50 reactors, which would produce 100 MW to 300 MW of heat. Alva's production director said the companies are not making an investment decision at this stage.
applications.microreactor_read: One LDR-50 is 50 MW thermal, above the 1-20 MW band, so a single block does not match this heat load. The study covers regulation, sites and costs first; there is no investment decision.
